The '''Brevost sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the sector included [[Archae Teuthis]], [[Brevost]], [[Coonee/Legends|Coonee]], [[Krann]] and [[Sika]].
